notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to mill four cards and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Release to the Wind from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, blinking Dihada.
Repeat.
